claim.quote: The technology is successfully demonstrated by a prototype detector. The final detector has been constructed.

key_value_text.quote: The technology is successfully demonstrated by a prototype detector. The final detector has been constructed.
key_value_text.value: Final detector constructed; Micromegas TPC performance demonstrated with a prototype

name: Status and Prospects of the PandaX-III Experiment

summary.plain: A prototype showed that the high-pressure xenon gas technology works, and the full PandaX-III detector has been built. It still has to be installed at the Jinping underground laboratory; no neutrinoless double beta result has been reported.
summary.technical: Status report: Micromegas-based TPC performance validated in the prototype detector (Shanghai); final detector (about 140 kg Xe at 10 bar, 52 thermal-bonding Micromegas modules) constructed and commissioned before installation at CJPL-II; expected 0.49 background counts/year in the region of interest.

title: Status and Prospects of the PandaX-III Experiment
why_it_matters: Marks the stage reached by PandaX-III; it is a technology and construction milestone, not a physics result.
